name: @threespot/visual-regression
description: Playwright-based cross-browser visual regression testing for Threespot client sites.

scripts.release:patch: bash -c 'read -p "Confirm new patch version (e.g. 0.1.0 → 0.1.1) to GitHub? (y/N) " -n 1 -r && echo && [[ "$REPLY" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] && yarn version:patch'
scripts.release:minor: bash -c 'read -p "Confirm new minor version (e.g. 0.1.0 → 0.2.0) to GitHub? (y/N) " -n 1 -r && echo && [[ "$REPLY" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] && yarn version:minor'
scripts.release:major: bash -c 'read -p "Confirm new major version (e.g. 0.1.0 → 1.0.0) to GitHub? (y/N) " -n 1 -r && echo && [[ "$REPLY" =~ ^[Yy]$ ]] && yarn version:major'
